full_track.tags: Lo-fi hip hop track at 85 BPM in C minor. A dusty, sampled acoustic piano plays a repetitive four-bar progression featuring minor seventh and major ninth chords with a high-cut filter and subtle wow and flutter pitch modulation. The drum kit consists of a thumping, slightly off-grid kick drum, a crisp snare with a short reverb tail, and a closed hi-hat pattern playing swung eighth notes. A warm, sub-heavy electric bass follows the piano root notes with a soft attack. Atmospheric vinyl crackle and ambient city street noise are layered throughout the arrangement. A melodic glockenspiel motif enters every eight bars, playing a descending pentatonic scale.
full_track.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[vinyl crackle and distant street noise]
[filtered acoustic piano enters with a four-bar loop]

[Main Theme]
[kick and snare enter with a swung hip hop beat]
[sub-bass follows piano root notes]
[closed hi-hats playing eighth notes]

[Bridge]
[piano filter closes further, reducing high-end clarity]
[glockenspiel melody enters with descending notes]

[Outro]
[drums and bass drop out]
[piano loop fades out with increasing reverb]
[vinyl crackle remains until silence]
